tagline.en: Vedic guidance for the decisions that shape your life
tagline.kn: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಜೀವನವನ್ನು ರೂಪಿಸುವ ನಿರ್ಧಾರಗಳಿಗೆ ವೈದಿಕ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶನ

street.kn: ೧೨, ಟೆಂಪಲ್ ಸ್ಟ್ರೀಟ್, ದೊಡ್ಡ ಬಸವನ ಗುಡಿ ಹತ್ತಿರ

hours.en: Open every day, 8 am to 8 pm

metaTitle.en: Vedic Astrologer in Bengaluru | Nakshatra Jyotishalaya

metaDescription.en: Kundli reading, marriage matching, Vastu and dosha remedies with Acharya Guruji in Basavanagudi, Bengaluru. In person, phone or video consultations.
metaDescription.kn: ಬಸವನಗುಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಆಚಾರ್ಯ ಗುರೂಜಿಯವರಿಂದ ಜಾತಕ ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಣೆ, ವಿವಾಹ ಹೊಂದಾಣಿಕೆ, ವಾಸ್ತು ಮತ್ತು ದೋಷ ಪರಿಹಾರ. ನೇರ, ಫೋನ್ ಅಥವಾ ವಿಡಿಯೋ ಸಮಾಲೋಚನೆ.

heading.en: Clarity for the questions that keep you up at night

text.en: Marriage, career, home and health, read from your birth chart by Acharya Guruji in Basavanagudi, Bengaluru.
text.kn: ವಿವಾಹ, ಉದ್ಯೋಗ, ಮನೆ ಮತ್ತು ಆರೋಗ್ಯ: ಬಸವನಗುಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಆಚಾರ್ಯ ಗುರೂಜಿಯವರಿಂದ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಜನ್ಮ ಕುಂಡಲಿಯ ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಣೆ.

text.en: Kundli matching that goes beyond the guna score, explained clearly to both families.
text.kn: ಗುಣ ಅಂಕಗಳನ್ನು ಮೀರಿದ ಜಾತಕ ಹೊಂದಾಣಿಕೆ, ಎರಡೂ ಕುಟುಂಬಗಳಿಗೆ ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟವಾಗಿ ವಿವರಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

heading.en: A home in harmony with its directions

text.en: Practical Vastu for homes, offices and plots, with no unnecessary demolition.
text.kn: ಮನೆ, ಕಚೇರಿ ಮತ್ತು ನಿವೇಶನಗಳಿಗೆ ಪ್ರಾಯೋಗಿಕ ವಾಸ್ತು, ಅನಗತ್ಯ ಕೆಡವುವಿಕೆ ಇಲ್ಲದೆ.

heading.en: A lifetime spent reading the sky

text.en: Acharya Guruji learned Jyotisha in the traditional guru-shishya way and has guided thousands of families across Karnataka for more than 25 years. His approach is calm and practical: understand the chart, explain it plainly, and suggest only the remedies that are genuinely needed.
text.kn: ಆಚಾರ್ಯ ಗುರೂಜಿ ಸಾಂಪ್ರದಾಯಿಕ ಗುರು-ಶಿಷ್ಯ ಪರಂಪರೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಜ್ಯೋತಿಷ್ಯ ಕಲಿತು, ೨೫ಕ್ಕೂ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ವರ್ಷಗಳಿಂದ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದಾದ್ಯಂತ ಸಾವಿರಾರು ಕುಟುಂಬಗಳಿಗೆ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶನ ನೀಡಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಅವರ ವಿಧಾನ ಶಾಂತ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರಾಯೋಗಿಕ.

text.en: You leave understanding your chart, not just holding a list of remedies.
text.kn: ಕೇವಲ ಪರಿಹಾರಗಳ ಪಟ್ಟಿಯಲ್ಲ, ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಂಡಲಿಯ ಅರ್ಥದೊಂದಿಗೆ ಹೊರಡುತ್ತೀರಿ.

text.en: Doshas are explained calmly. Pujas are suggested only when truly indicated.
text.kn: ದೋಷಗಳನ್ನು ಶಾಂತವಾಗಿ ವಿವರಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಅಗತ್ಯವಿದ್ದಾಗ ಮಾತ್ರ ಪೂಜೆ.

text.en: Parashari and Jaimini systems, learned in the guru-shishya parampara.
text.kn: ಗುರು-ಶಿಷ್ಯ ಪರಂಪರೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕಲಿತ ಪರಾಶರ ಮತ್ತು ಜೈಮಿನಿ ಪದ್ಧತಿಗಳು.

text.en: Birth details and consultations are never shared with anyone.
text.kn: ಜನ್ಮ ವಿವರಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಸಮಾಲೋಚನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಯಾರೊಂದಿಗೂ ಹಂಚಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

quote.en: The planets do not decide your life. They show you the season you are in, so you can sow and harvest at the right time.
quote.kn: ಗ್ರಹಗಳು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಜೀವನವನ್ನು ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ನೀವು ಯಾವ ಋತುವಿನಲ್ಲಿದ್ದೀರಿ ಎಂದು ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತವೆ, ಸರಿಯಾದ ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಿತ್ತಿ ಬೆಳೆಯಲು.

answer.en: Appointments are recommended so Guruji can prepare your chart in advance. Message us on WhatsApp to book.
answer.kn: ಗುರೂಜಿ ಮುಂಚಿತವಾಗಿ ಕುಂಡಲಿ ಸಿದ್ಧಪಡಿಸಲು ಸಮಯ ನಿಗದಿ ಉತ್ತಮ. ವಾಟ್ಸಾಪ್ ಮೂಲಕ ಬುಕ್ ಮಾಡಿ.

question.en: Can I consult over the phone or video?

answer.en: Yes. Phone and video consultations are available for clients anywhere in India and abroad.
answer.kn: ಹೌದು. ಭಾರತ ಮತ್ತು ವಿದೇಶದ ಎಲ್ಲಿಂದಲಾದರೂ ಫೋನ್ ಮತ್ತು ವಿಡಿಯೋ ಸಮಾಲೋಚನೆ ಲಭ್ಯ.

answer.en: Your date, exact time and place of birth. For matching, the same for both partners.
answer.kn: ಜನ್ಮ ದಿನಾಂಕ, ನಿಖರ ಸಮಯ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ಥಳ. ಹೊಂದಾಣಿಕೆಗೆ ಇಬ್ಬರದ್ದೂ.

intro.en: Vedic astrologer, Vastu consultant and teacher, practising in Basavanagudi, Bengaluru since 1998.
intro.kn: ೧೯೯೮ರಿಂದ ಬೆಂಗಳೂರಿನ ಬಸವನಗುಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ವೈದಿಕ ಜ್ಯೋತಿಷಿ, ವಾಸ್ತು ಸಲಹೆಗಾರ ಮತ್ತು ಶಿಕ್ಷಕ.

children.text: Born into a family of temple priests in coastal Karnataka, Guruji began studying Sanskrit and the Jyotisha shastras as a boy under his grandfather, and later under a renowned scholar of the Parashari tradition.
After more than a decade of study he began consulting in Bengaluru in 1998. Today families who first came to him for their own marriage return for their children's horoscopes.
Guruji believes astrology should bring clarity and calm, never fear. Consultations are unhurried, remedies are simple, and every client is treated with discretion.

text.en: Traditional title conferred after 12 years of study.
text.kn: ೧೨ ವರ್ಷಗಳ ಅಧ್ಯಯನದ ನಂತರ ನೀಡಲಾದ ಸಾಂಪ್ರದಾಯಿಕ ಪದವಿ.

text.en: Trained in classical Vastu texts including Mayamata.
text.kn: ಮಯಮತ ಸೇರಿದಂತೆ ಶಾಸ್ತ್ರೀಯ ವಾಸ್ತು ಗ್ರಂಥಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ತರಬೇತಿ.

text.en: Has taught Jyotisha to over 200 students.
text.kn: ೨೦೦ಕ್ಕೂ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಜ್ಯೋತಿಷ್ಯ ಬೋಧನೆ.

mission.en: To help every family that walks in leave with clarity, calm and a practical plan.
mission.kn: ಬರುವ ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದು ಕುಟುಂಬವೂ ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟತೆ, ಶಾಂತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರಾಯೋಗಿಕ ಯೋಜನೆಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಹೊರಡುವಂತೆ ಮಾಡುವುದು.

bio.en: Acharya Guruji has practised Vedic astrology in Bengaluru since 1998, guiding families on marriage, career, Vastu and remedies.
bio.kn: ಆಚಾರ್ಯ ಗುರೂಜಿ ೧೯೯೮ರಿಂದ ಬೆಂಗಳೂರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ವೈದಿಕ ಜ್ಯೋತಿಷ್ಯ ಅಭ್ಯಾಸ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದು, ವಿವಾಹ, ಉದ್ಯೋಗ, ವಾಸ್ತು ಮತ್ತು ಪರಿಹಾರಗಳ ಕುರಿತು ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶನ ನೀಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದಾರೆ.

shortDescription.en: A complete reading of your birth chart: strengths, timing and the road ahead.
shortDescription.kn: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಜನ್ಮ ಕುಂಡಲಿಯ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಣೆ: ಶಕ್ತಿ, ಕಾಲ ಮತ್ತು ಮುಂದಿನ ದಾರಿ.

children.text: Your kundli is a map of the sky at the moment you were born. Read carefully, it shows the themes that run through your life: temperament, relationships, work, health and the periods when each comes into focus.
What the reading covers
Lagna, Moon sign and planetary strengths
Current and upcoming Mahadasha and Antardasha
Career, finances, marriage and family
Practical remedies where they are genuinely useful

en.text: Bring your exact time of birth if you have it. Even a 15-minute difference can change the Lagna.

whySeek.en: A second opinion on a chart

question.en: What if I do not know my exact birth time?

answer.en: Guruji can rectify the birth time using key life events such as marriage, the birth of children or changes of job.
answer.kn: ವಿವಾಹ, ಮಕ್ಕಳ ಜನನ, ಉದ್ಯೋಗ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಯಂತಹ ಘಟನೆಗಳಿಂದ ಗುರೂಜಿ ಜನ್ಮ ಸಮಯವನ್ನು ಸರಿಪಡಿಸಬಹುದು.

answer.en: Usually 45 to 60 minutes, with time for your questions.
answer.kn: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿ ೪೫ ರಿಂದ ೬೦ ನಿಮಿಷ, ನಿಮ್ಮ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳಿಗೂ ಸಮಯವಿರುತ್ತದೆ.

text.en: An unhurried conversation in person, by phone or on video.

shortDescription.en: Guna milan and a deeper compatibility reading for couples and families.
shortDescription.kn: ಗುಣ ಮಿಲನ ಮತ್ತು ದಂಪತಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಆಳವಾದ ಹೊಂದಾಣಿಕೆ ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಣೆ.

children.text: A guna score is only the starting point. Guruji also looks at the 7th house, Venus and Jupiter, Mangal dosha in both charts and the dasha periods each partner is entering, so the family gets a complete picture.
When to consult
Before fixing an alliance
When marriage is being delayed
Choosing a muhurta for the wedding

answer.en: It is the traditional minimum, but planetary compatibility matters as much as the score. Guruji explains both.

children.text: Most Vastu imbalances can be corrected with changes to how rooms are used, where heavy furniture sits and simple placements. Guruji visits sites across Bengaluru or reviews floor plans remotely.

en.text: Have a floor plan ready, with north marked, before the visit.

whySeek.en: Buying a new home or plot

answer.en: Yes. Send the floor plan with north marked and Guruji will review it on a video call.

children.text: Doshas are often described in frightening terms. In reality many are mild or cancelled by other factors in the chart. Guruji first confirms whether a dosha is actually present and how strong it is, and only then suggests remedies such as japa, a specific puja or charity.

title.en: Understanding the 12 houses in your kundli

excerpt.en: Each house in a birth chart speaks to one area of life. Here is a plain-language guide to what each one means.
excerpt.kn: ಜನ್ಮ ಕುಂಡಲಿಯ ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದು ಭಾವವೂ ಜೀವನದ ಒಂದು ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರವನ್ನು ಸೂಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದರ ಅರ್ಥಕ್ಕೆ ಸರಳ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶಿ.

children.text: A kundli is divided into twelve houses, or bhavas. Each one governs a different part of life, and the planets sitting in them, along with the signs they fall in, colour how that part of life unfolds.
The houses of self: 1st, 5th and 9th
The 1st house (Lagna) is you: body, temperament and how you meet the world. The 5th covers children, creativity and intelligence, and the 9th covers dharma, teachers and fortune.
The houses of wealth: 2nd, 6th and 10th
The 2nd house shows family and accumulated wealth, the 6th daily work, health and competition, and the 10th career and public standing.

en.text: No single house tells the whole story. A good reading always looks at the house, its lord, and the planets aspecting it together.

children.text: The houses of relationships: 3rd, 7th and 11th
The 3rd governs siblings and courage, the 7th marriage and partnerships, and the 11th friends, networks and gains.
The houses of liberation: 4th, 8th and 12th
The 4th is home and mother, the 8th transformation and longevity, and the 12th expenses, foreign lands and spiritual release.

en.heading: Want to know what your houses say?

children.text: ಕುಂಡಲಿಯನ್ನು ಹನ್ನೆರಡು ಭಾವಗಳಾಗಿ ವಿಂಗಡಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದು ಭಾವವೂ ಜೀವನದ ಒಂದು ಭಾಗವನ್ನು ಆಳುತ್ತದೆ, ಮತ್ತು ಅದರಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಗ್ರಹಗಳು ಆ ಭಾಗ ಹೇಗೆ ತೆರೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.
ಸ್ವಭಾವದ ಭಾವಗಳು: ೧, ೫ ಮತ್ತು ೯
ಮೊದಲ ಭಾವ (ಲಗ್ನ) ನೀವೇ: ದೇಹ, ಸ್ವಭಾವ ಮತ್ತು ಜಗತ್ತನ್ನು ಎದುರಿಸುವ ರೀತಿ. ಐದನೇ ಭಾವ ಮಕ್ಕಳು ಮತ್ತು ಬುದ್ಧಿ, ಒಂಬತ್ತನೇ ಭಾವ ಧರ್ಮ, ಗುರು ಮತ್ತು ಭಾಗ್ಯ.
ಸಂಪತ್ತಿನ ಭಾವಗಳು: ೨, ೬ ಮತ್ತು ೧೦
ಎರಡನೇ ಭಾವ ಕುಟುಂಬ ಮತ್ತು ಧನ, ಆರನೇ ಭಾವ ದೈನಂದಿನ ಕೆಲಸ ಮತ್ತು ಆರೋಗ್ಯ, ಹತ್ತನೇ ಭಾವ ವೃತ್ತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ಥಾನಮಾನ.

kn.text: ಯಾವುದೇ ಒಂದು ಭಾವ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಕಥೆ ಹೇಳುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಭಾವ, ಅದರ ಅಧಿಪತಿ ಮತ್ತು ದೃಷ್ಟಿ ಬೀರುವ ಗ್ರಹಗಳನ್ನು ಒಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ನೋಡಬೇಕು.

title.en: Mangal dosha before marriage: what it really means

excerpt.en: Mangal dosha is one of the most feared terms in matchmaking, and one of the most misunderstood. A calm look at the facts.

children.text: Mangal dosha (also called Kuja dosha) is said to be present when Mars occupies the 1st, 2nd, 4th, 7th, 8th or 12th house. By that definition, nearly half of all charts would have it, which is a sign that the rule is not meant to be applied mechanically.
When the dosha is cancelled
Mars in its own sign or exalted
Both partners having comparable Mangal dosha
Strong Jupiter aspecting Mars or the 7th house

en.text: Never cancel an alliance on the word "Mangal dosha" alone. Ask for the full chart comparison.

title.en: Seven Vastu tips for a peaceful home

excerpt.en: Small changes to light, layout and clutter that make a real difference, no renovation needed.

children.text: Vastu is ultimately about light, air and the flow of daily life. These simple adjustments are worth trying before anything structural.
1. Keep the north-east open and clean
This is the most sacred corner of the home. Avoid heavy storage, toilets or clutter here.
2. Sleep with your head to the south
Traditional texts recommend south or east. Avoid north.
3. Let morning light into the east
Open east-facing windows in the morning and keep them uncovered by heavy curtains.

title.en: What is Sade Sati, and should you worry?

excerpt.en: Saturn's seven-and-a-half-year transit has a fearsome reputation. Here is what it actually does, and how to move through it well.

children.text: Sade Sati is the period when Saturn transits the sign before your Moon sign, your Moon sign itself, and the sign after it. Each phase lasts about two and a half years.
Saturn is a teacher. Sade Sati often brings responsibility, hard work and a clearing-out of what is not working. For many people it is also a time of real, lasting achievement.
